create_TransposeLast_module: create a TransposeLast module that transposes the last two dimensions of a tensor
create_TransposeLast_with_deconstruct: create a TransposeLast module with deconstruct_idx to index into a tuple before transposing
run_TransposeLast_forward: run the TransposeLast forward pass on a tensor to swap its last two dimensions
review_TransposeLast_class: review the TransposeLast class and its forward method for tensor dimension transposition
test_TransposeLast_deconstruct: test the TransposeLast module with deconstruct_idx to select and transpose a tensor from a tuple
